text: The purpose of this Motion is to seek City Council's authority to appoint Nick Samonas as Deputy Chief Building Official effective as soon as possible. This Motion is urgent as the appointment of the Director and Deputy Chief Building Official is required as soon as possible to meet City needs.

City Council on November 8 and 9, 2023, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint Nick Samonas as Deputy Chief Building Official for the City of Toronto, with all the powers and duties of the Chief Building Official within the district of the City of Toronto assigned by the Chief Building Official and Executive Director, Toronto Building. 2. City Council revoke the appointment of Bill Stamatopoulos as Deputy Chief Building Official for the City of Toronto effective immediately. 3. City Council authorize and direct appropriate City officials to take the necessary action to give effect to City Council's decision, including the introduction of any necessary bills.
